Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects wire EDM geometry and the resulting XYUV path.
I checked the laws in upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`.

What looks good:

- The mapping holds removed spans at the trim vertex and keeps surviving edges in source order.
- Unsupported matches, duplicate turns, and conflicting knots produce named refusals.
- The emitted path still passes cover, folds, crossing, lean, and clearance checks against the unhealed product.
- The decision record explains the source matching and the rejected alternatives.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2805`. No GitHub runner was used.
The initial trial merge used main `e048b103ca649e24048268e1a050f0b4686a997a`; the PR already contained that main.
The 12-step quick gate passed. Clippy passed with `-D warnings` for all motion targets.

The motion lib run left ten ignored tests for the heavy lane.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 217 planned steps in 38.5 minutes.
The command ran every reached motion and app lane in release mode with `--ignored`.
There were 98 passing tests. The three registered `#1950` checks failed at their expected assertions and passed the gate checks.

Upstream main advanced during the run with the tool-change macro fix in PR #2798.
I then trial-merged main `3970d3d0319e423761c48f9a7e0a6391a14b9403` without a conflict.
The motion source did not change. I repeated the selected app checks on the combined tree.
`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only app` passed all 62 steps: one build and 61 suites, with 449 passing tests.
The full heavy result above predates that post-only main update.

Extra suites run:

- The PR changes no test data, fixture directories, goldens, or importer code. The extra-suite rules add no suites.
- The main-update recheck ran all 61 app suites selected by the gate, including the eight wire and CL suites above.

Mutations repeated independently:

1. Restore geometric-length interpolation in `Ring::at`: the interpolation pin fails at X6 instead of X5. Restore the fix: pass.
2. Restore geometric-length projection in `Ring::nearest`: the projection pin fails at arc 4 instead of arc 5. Restore the fix: pass.

Both mutations produced assertion failures, not build failures. The original source was restored after each check.
No golden files moved, including NC and CL goldens. There were no changed golden lines to inspect.
The PR changes no UI files, so screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge: none.

No physical machine run or full release gate was performed.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
